row: r2: c1 set by p2 in a row deleted by p1; row restore --row r2 brings it back
col: r1: c2 set by p2 in a column deleted by bot; col restore --col c2 brings it back
both: r2: c2 set by p2 in a row deleted by p1 and a column deleted by bot; row restore --row r2 and col restore --col c2 bring it back
row, header on: r2: c1 set by p2 in a row deleted by p1; row restore --row r2 brings it back
